messages:
From: Janet Murray <jane.murray@heliocloud.com>

Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HelioCloud marketplace onboarding & PO routing

Hi Vanessa,

Quick intro — I’m Janet (Head of Cloud Partnerships at HelioCloud). We’re preparing to list HelioCloud on AWS, GCP and Azure marketplaces and would like Redwood listed as our integration partner for managed inference. We completed your intake form and attached our W-9. Can you confirm the procurement/onboarding checklist and who at Redwood signs the Marketplace Order Form? A few specific asks: 

- Which Redwood contact should I route our PO to once our procurement team raises it?
- Any marketplace-specific evidence (SOC2 scope, SLAs, third-party attestations) we should attach up front?
- Expected timeline: how long from DocuSign to live listing if paperwork is complete?

Attaching: HelioCloud_Onboarding_Form.pdf, HelioCloud_W-9.pdf

We’d like to move quickly; can you advise next steps and internal contacts?

Thanks,
Janet Murray
Head of Cloud Partnerships
HelioCloud
janet.murray@heliocloud.com
procurement@heliocloud.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Janet Murray <jane.murray@heliocloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCloud marketplace onboarding & PO routing

Hi Janet — welcome, and thanks for the completed form + W-9. Short answers up front: Ben in Finance is the PO contact and will confirm billing entity and invoice remit instructions; Kim (Legal/Marketplace) will validate the marketplace agreement flags. Typical timeline (paperwork complete): 5–10 business days for DocuSign and procurement handshake, then marketplace portal submission varies by provider (AWS often ~3–7 business days after partner onboarding; GCP similar).

Next steps I’ll kick off: 
1) Ben — can you confirm Redwood’s PO routing parameters and if we need a separate MSLA signatory? (see attached Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf)
2) Janet — please share a short SOC2 summary (scope + date of last report) and any data residency/KMS requirements. Also confirm the legal name and remit address for the PO.
3) We’ll send the Marketplace Order Form via DocuSign (link below) once finance confirms remit details.

Helpful links: DocuSign (Marketplaces agreement): https://app.docusign.com/HelioCloud/RDWD-Marketplace-Agreement
AWS partner portal: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/partner-portal/
GCP partner submission console: https://console.cloud.google.com/partner/marketplace

Attaching: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (internal PO routing + invoice matrix)

I’ll keep this thread as the coordination channel — looping Ben and Kim to their parts.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Please use the remit address below on the PO and route via procurement@redwood.com. We accept Net30 by default for marketplace listings; if HelioCloud needs a different payment term please note it on the PO.

Billing name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Remit address: 2200 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94114
Invoice email: invoices@redwood.com (cc procurement@redwood.com)
PO reference: Include DEAL-2026-1543 on the PO

Janet — attach SOC2 summary and we’ll validate whether additional evidence is required for AWS/GCP. I’ve attached a Redwood_PO_Template.docx to make the PO formatting easier for your procurement. If HelioCloud prefers to send a Supplier invoice first, we can accept that and convert once PO is issued.

Ben Carter

- Expected go-live target: request is to complete DocuSign and portal submission this month (Aug) — any blocker on Redwood’s end?
